info.name: TradeExpertGrid - Job Flow, Location Restriction & Messaging
info.description:
End-to-end collection for the TradeExpertGrid job flow, including the geo/location restriction on job discovery and the messaging/inbox + notifications endpoints.

Conventions:
- No global prefix: every path already includes the literal `/v1` segment.
- Success responses are wrapped as `{ "message": string, "data": <payload> }`.
- Paginated payloads are `{ page, size, pageTotal, hasNext, hasPrevious, data: [...] }` nested inside `data`.
- Login returns the JWT at `data.token` (this collection captures it into `{{homeOwnerToken}}`, `{{tradePersonToken}}` and `{{adminToken}}`).
- Global ValidationPipe uses `whitelist: true` and `forbidNonWhitelisted: true`: unknown body fields return 400.
- AuthGuard returns 403 (not 401) when the bearer token is missing/invalid.
- Run requests top-to-bottom; id variables are captured automatically by test scripts.

Location restriction (see the "3. Location Restriction" folder):
A trade person calling GET /v1/jobs only sees jobs within SERVICE_RADIUS_KM kilometres (default 10) of the location stored on their KYC profile, plus visibility rules (PUBLIC, or PRIVATE assigned to them). The radius is NOT a request parameter - it is an env var. To exercise it, first run "Trade Person: Complete Address Verification" with a `location` (GeoJSON Point).

item.name: 0. Auth
item.description: Obtain bearer tokens for each actor. Tokens and user ids are stored in collection variables for the rest of the run.

request.description: Home owner login. Captures `data.token` -> {{homeOwnerToken}} and `data._id` -> {{homeOwnerId}}.
Trade person login. Captures `data.token` -> {{tradePersonToken}} and `data._id` -> {{tradePersonId}} (also used as a messaging recipient).
Admin login (requires role ADMIN/ROOT for the flows below). Captures `data.token` -> {{adminToken}}.

item.name: 1. Location Setup (KYC Prerequisites)
item.description: The location restriction for jobs is driven by the trade person's KYC profile location. Run "Complete Address Verification" with a `location` GeoJSON Point to become discoverable / to filter nearby jobs. Bank details and admin KYC approval are also required before payment release.

request.description: Check which KYC steps are complete (profile, identity, health & safety, police report, bank details, main trade).

item.name: Trade Person: Complete Address Verification (sets service location)

request.description: Sets the trade person's service location on the KYC profile. `location.coordinates` must be GeoJSON `[longitude, latitude]` (exactly 2 numbers). This is what GET /v1/jobs uses to restrict results to SERVICE_RADIUS_KM (default 10 km). Use coordinates near the job's `locationCoordinates` so the job is returned.
Required before an admin can release payment to the trade person (a Paystack transfer recipient is created from this account).
Approves the trade person KYC (required for payment release). `{{tradePersonId}}` is captured by the Trade Person Login request.

item.name: 2. Job Flow
item.description: Job request -> quotation -> admin review -> home owner accept -> payment -> verification -> completion -> payment release -> review. Status model: JobRequest.status = OPEN | QUOTATION_PAID | COMPLETED. Quotation.reviewStatus = PENDING | ADMIN_APPROVED | ADMIN_REJECTED | HOMEOWNER_ACCEPTED | HOMEOWNER_REJECTED | PAYMENT_COMPLETED.

request.description: Public. Captures the first job type id into {{jobTypeId}} for job creation.

item.name: Home Owner: Create Job (PUBLIC, with location)

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Fix leaking kitchen sink",
  "description": "The kitchen sink is leaking from under the cabinet",
  "budget": 500000,
  "currency": "NGN",
  "preferredDate": "2026-08-10",
  "preferredTime": "14:00",
  "homeAddress": "12 Baker Street, Lagos",
  "locationCoordinates": [3.3792, 6.5244],
  "photos": ["https://example.com/photo1.jpg"],
  "jobTypeId": "{{jobTypeId}}",
  "visibility": "PUBLIC"
}

request.description:
Creates a job request. Requires AuthGuard + KycGuard (home owner KYC complete). `locationCoordinates` is `[longitude, latitude]`; when present and PUBLIC, tradespersons within SERVICE_RADIUS_KM whose main trade matches the job type are notified. Captures the new job id -> {{jobRequestId}}.

Note: `budget` is in minor units (kobo). `visibility` is PUBLIC or PRIVATE; PRIVATE requires `tradespersonId`.

item.name: Home Owner: Create Job (PRIVATE, direct to tradesperson)

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Emergency pipe repair",
  "description": "Burst pipe under the kitchen sink",
  "budget": 250000,
  "currency": "NGN",
  "homeAddress": "12 Baker Street, Lagos",
  "locationCoordinates": [3.3792, 6.5244],
  "jobTypeId": "{{jobTypeId}}",
  "visibility": "PRIVATE",
  "tradespersonId": "{{tradePersonId}}"
}

request.description: PRIVATE variant: only the assigned `tradespersonId` is notified and can see the job (geo restriction does not apply). Captures the new job id -> {{jobRequestId}}.
For a home owner, returns their own job requests (no geo restriction). Optional `q` filters by title. Captures the first job id if {{jobRequestId}} is empty.
Admin only. Paginated list of ALL job requests with NO geospatial filtering.

Trade person only (@RequireUserType(TRADESPERSON)). One quotation per (job, trade person). `totalAmount` = sum(quantity * unitPrice + vat) over materials/tools + sum(workmanship.price). All prices are in minor units (kobo). Captures the quotation id -> {{quotationId}}.
Returns this trade person's quotation for the job (if any).
Only allowed while the quotation is PENDING. All three arrays are optional in updates.
Allowed only when the quotation was rejected by the home owner or admin (HOMEOWNER_REJECTED / ADMIN_REJECTED). Snapshots the previous version into revision history.
Revision history for the quotation.
Deletes the trade person's pending quotation.
Admin only. Lists all quotations for the job. Captures the first quotation id -> {{quotationId}} if not already set.
Records an ADMIN_REVIEW event. No body.
Moves the quotation to ADMIN_APPROVED. Only one quotation per job may be admin-approved (concurrency-guarded). After approval the home owner can see it and accept.
Rejects the quotation. `reason` is required by the service when rejecting. Use this OR the approve request, not both, for a given quotation.
Home owner only. Returns admin-approved quotations for a job they created. Captures the first quotation id -> {{quotationId}} if not set.
Returns the accepted quotation for the job (after acceptance).
Home owner accepts an ADMIN_APPROVED quotation (only one accepted per job).
Rejects an admin-approved quotation; the trade person may then revise it.
Initializes a Paystack transaction for the full accepted amount and returns `authorizationUrl`, `accessCode` and `reference`. Captures `data.reference` -> {{jobPaymentReference}}.

PUBLIC (no auth). Verifies the payment with Paystack. On success: Payment=SUCCESS, quotation=PAYMENT_COMPLETED, job=QUOTATION_PAID, and a 4-digit verification code is generated and sent to the trade person via messaging.
PUBLIC (no auth). Only reacts to `charge.success`, then performs the same verification as the callback. Note: this route uses an inline body type, so DTO validation does not apply.
Trade person (assigned, paid job) asks the home owner to mark the job complete. Sends a message to the home owner.
Home owner views the 4-digit code generated at payment. Captures `data.code` -> {{verificationCode}}.
Home owner verifies the code presented by the trade person. `code` must be exactly 4 characters.
Marks the job COMPLETED and starts the 14-day satisfactory period (satisfactoryPeriodEndsAt = now + 14 days).
Admin only. Records QA approval, which allows the balance payment to be released before the 14-day period elapses.
Admin only. Requires the job to be COMPLETED, plus an APPROVED trade person KYC and bank account. Releases `amount * upfrontReleasePercentage%` (default 50%; config `upfrontReleasePercentage`).
Admin only. Requires the INITIAL release to be done AND (QA approved OR the 14-day satisfactory period elapsed). Releases the remaining balance. A daily cron also auto-releases balances at midnight.
Admin only. Returns the quotation event log (QUOTE_SUBMITTED, ADMIN_REVIEW, QUOTE_APPROVED, QUOTE_REJECTED, RESIDENT_PAID, PAYMENT_RELEASED, JOB_COMPLETED, QA_APPROVED).
Home owner reviews the trade person after the job is COMPLETED. One review per job/home owner. `rating` is an integer 1-5.
PUBLIC (no auth). Returns `{ reviews, averageRating, total }` for the trade person.
Trade person only. Lists contracts derived from assigned jobs + quotations. Optional `status` filter: PENDING | ACTIVE | COMPLETED.

item.name: 3. Location Restriction
item.description:
How job discovery is restricted by location.

Rule: a trade person calling GET /v1/jobs sees only jobs whose `location` is within SERVICE_RADIUS_KM kilometres (env var, default 10) of the location on their KYC profile, AND that are visible to them (PUBLIC, or PRIVATE assigned to them). Jobs without coordinates, or a trade person without a KYC location, fall back to visibility-only filtering (no distance restriction). The radius is NOT a query parameter.

Prerequisite: run "Trade Person: Complete Address Verification" with a `location` so the trade person has coordinates.

Related (non-geo) endpoints: admin job list (no geo filter) and the public trade person directory (no proximity filter).

request.description: Trade person view. Results are restricted to within SERVICE_RADIUS_KM (default 10 km) of the trade person's KYC location and to PUBLIC / PRIVATE-assigned jobs. If the trade person has no KYC location, only visibility filtering applies. Captures the first job id -> {{jobRequestId}} if not set.
PUBLIC. Approved trade persons with complete KYC. No proximity/geo filter is applied on this endpoint (no query params).

item.name: 4. Messaging & Inbox
item.description:
HTTP messaging/chat endpoints. All require a bearer token; the JWT `userType` becomes the message `senderType`.

Realtime: a socket.io gateway is mounted at namespace `/messages` (same host/port). Handshake auth via `auth.token` or `query.token`. Client events: `send_message` {recipientId,recipientType,content}, `send_job_message` {recipientId,recipientType,jobRequestId,content}, `mark_read` {messageId}, `join` {userType,userId}. Server events: `message_sent`, `message_read`, `new_message`, `new_notification`, `joined`, `error`. Sockets are not exercised by Postman HTTP requests.

request.description: Sends a GENERAL message. `recipientId` must be a Mongo id; `recipientType` is the recipient's userType (HOME_OWNER or TRADES_PERSON). Emits `message.created` -> gateway `new_message` to the recipient room.
Sends a JOB-scoped message (type=JOB, jobRequest set).
Returns all messages for the job as an array (ordered oldest first, not paginated).
Paginated inbox for the current user (newest first). Captures the first message id -> {{messageId}}.
Paginated conversation between the current user and `{{otherUserId}}` (ordered oldest first). Set {{otherUserId}} to the counterpart id (e.g. the trade person id when logged in as a home owner).
Marks a message as read. Only the recipient may do this (otherwise 404). The `isRead` body field is accepted but ignored by the service; the body is otherwise optional.

item.name: 5. Notifications
item.description: Notification/inbox-adjacent endpoints. All require a bearer token and are scoped to the current user + userType.

request.description: Registers/upserts a push device token. `provider` defaults to `onesignal`.
Paginated notifications for the current user (newest first), plus `unreadCount`. Captures the first notification id -> {{notificationId}}.
Marks all notifications for the current user as read.
Marks a single notification as read (scoped to the current user + userType). Returns the updated notification or null.
